verdict.rationale: Reflect supports simple #tags (auto-applied e.g. #book on Kindle imports) and lets users filter/search notes by tags, backlinks, dates, and pinned status, giving basic tag-based organization and retrieval. However, there is no evidence of 'typed properties' (structured metadata fields with data types, like Notion-style properties) — only flat hashtags and backlinks are documented. Missing for 10: typed/structured property support, evidence of consistent property schemas across notes, and any UI for defining custom property types.
